project.name: Remis：新秩序黎明（Luna 开发预览 v2）
project.research_question: Separate concrete event chains from archive-only founding lore and static reference assets. Build an evidence-backed register of plot-central named people, organizations, places, polities, technologies, concepts, and items, then link concrete event steps to those entities. Treat repeated dot-number, dot-letter, or other suffix families as structural hints, confirm membership against text, and cite source_item_id evidence for every published item.

source_items.text: Dawn of a New Order
Amidst thunderous applause, liberty died. Empress Remis declares the reorganization of the Galactic Republic.

The skyline of §H [Root.GetCapitalName]§! was obscured by the shadows of a thousand Titan-class warships, blotting out the sun like a swarm of locusts. deep within the heart of §Y The Curia Caelestis§!, Supreme Chancellor Remis rose from her hovering podium.

Her voice, amplified by the psychic network, resonated in the minds of every sentient being across the sector:

"Citizens! The chaos of the Republic has festered for too long. We have been bled dry by the greed of megacorporations and the incompetence of a gridlocked senate. But today, the bleeding stops. To ensure the stability and security of our future, I am authorizing the immediate activation of the §R Sublimation Protocol§!."

She paused, her golden eyes scanning the terrified delegates, her smile cold and absolute:

"We are not merely building a government; we are forging an eternal sanctuary. This is not just law; this is §L Pax Remisia§!. Under this peace, dissent is obsolete, and silence is the highest virtue."
So this is how liberty dies...
Hail the Empress! (Join the §Y Vigilantes Aeturni§!)
We will never kneel! (Declare War)
Silence in the Halls
Political opponents are disappearing at an alarming rate.

It started as a rumor. Then, it became a pattern. Senators who voiced opposition to the new regime simply ceased to attend sessions. When asked about their whereabouts, the new head of security merely smiled and adjusted his gloves.

"Senator Valerius? I believe he has... retired to a countryside estate to reflect on the virtues of loyalty," said the officer of the §Y Vigilantes Aeturni§!, his hand resting casually on his sidearm. "It is amazing how clarifying the §L Pax Remisia§! can be for a clouded mind. One moment, you are shouting about 'rights'; the next, you realize that 'duty' is the only word that matters."

Behind him, the heavy doors of the detention block slammed shut, muffling a sound that was suspiciously like a scream.
I see nothing. I hear nothing.
This tyranny cannot stand.
§Y Argentum-9§! Refinement

By compressing raw void energy within a hyper-dense lattice, we can synthesize a highly unstable isotope: §H Argentum-9§!. This substance is the core power source for the power armor of the §Y Vigilantes Aeturni§!, granting them reaction times that border on precognition. It hums with a sound that some describe as 'the weeping of stars'.
Sublimation Neural Interface

To realize the grand vision of §L Pax Remisia§!, we must eliminate the friction of individual misunderstanding. By mandating the §R Sublimation Protocol§! chip for all Level-5 citizens, we synchronize their emotional baselines with the Central Palace. Happiness is no longer a pursuit; it is a broadcast.
Sol-Lance
A directed-energy weapon that focuses the fury of a captive star. As the Empress once stated: "The light of the Sol-Lance does not merely burn; it reveals the truth hidden in the dark."
§L Pax Remisia§!
True peace is not the absence of war, but the absence of dissent. We hold Order as the highest of all virtues, eclipsing the petty chaotic nature of Freedom.
Eternal Vigilance
Our §Y Vigilantes Aeturni§! are everywhere. Every whisper in a dark alley, every skipped beat of a treacherous heart, falls under the gaze of the Empire. Privacy is the shield of the guilty.
Argentum Standard
By monopolizing the extraction of §H Argentum-9§!, we hold the galaxy by its throat. Any system that dares to rebel will find its reactors cold and its cities dark within a standard week.
Absolute Sublimation

The individual is fragile; the collective is eternal. We shall complete the §R Sublimation Protocol§!, merging the consciousness of all subjects into a singular, harmonious will. We shall become the State, in body and in soul.
